{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vanishing Place''' was a prison established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gilder Varth]] was interned there before being rescued by the [[Alderaanian Resistance]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vischera]] worked there.
